Multifamily Housing and Condominium Overview

With an increase in demand for luxury living accommodations in Las Vegas and a 100% sell out of the existing supply of recently delivered residential units, condominium prices have increased dramatically. The depth of demand far exceeds the amount of new supply forecasted over the next five years. In addition, the economies of scale associated with new residential, retail, hotel and office development on the Las
Vegas Strip will only elevate the overall appeal of Strip living - and in turn push condominium values higher.
